activity_summary: At the lodging you looked at three cues on the afternoon's roll: Lord Hastings, my liege, and madam. You set no name over them. The comedy stayed shut, with the refusal still marked. You went out to play at two.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the three cues, left the comedy shut, and went to play.

facets.activity: Read the three cues and went out
